multi_entity_note: Single patient with tetralogy of Fallot and infective endocarditis.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: 'The final diagnosis was tetralogy of Fallot (TOF)', superseding the childhood diagnosis of VSD.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: TOF was treated surgically; ceftriaxone treated infective endocarditis and nifedipine/candesartan hypertension, so no drug for the final diagnosis is named.
